description: Defines a template class FactoryType for creating and managing factory objects, including nested classes for factory iteration and internal factory implementation.

classes.name: FactoryType
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of factory objects, allowing creation, destruction, and iteration over factories.

classes.name: FactoryType::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the factories within FactoryType.

classes.name: FactoryType::IFactory
classes.description: An interface for factory objects, providing methods to get elements and query counts.

classes.name: FactoryType::InternalFactoryType
classes.description: A concrete implementation of IFactory, managing a pool of factory elements.

methods.name: DestroyFactories
methods.description: Deletes all factory objects managed by FactoryType.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Deletes a specific factory identified by its ID.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory for a specific element type with an initial queue size.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a proxy to a factory element by its identifier.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Returns a proxy to a factory element by its identifier.

methods.name: Factories
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all factories.
